alt: 朋友誠懇指著桌上歪斜不穩的陶瓶，製作者抱著手皺眉聆聽，神情不悅。
scene_prompt: In an adult shared art studio a sincere friend gently points out an actual visible flaw in a ceramic vase: its base leans crookedly and it wobbles on the table. The maker folds arms and frowns in displeasure while listening; the friend has a kind concerned expression and offers a steadying hand rather than laughing. Show honest helpful criticism that is unpleasant to hear. No speech bubbles needed.
